notes.title: First Update.
notes.content:
- Two buttons to adjust volume of the game (left arrow and right arrow)
- A button to change screen mode (F11 to fullscreen/windowned)
- Some tweks on world generation

Working on:

-More achievments and icons for them
-More Music variety and music styles


For now, that's all. Currently, I'm more focused on the music and achievements. I look forward to community feedback so that I can implement more challenges and better balance world generation.
